subject.title: feat: add opt-in telemetry for native chat lifecycle

question: Should native chat publish this full turn, phase, history, and terminal-outcome telemetry contract now while gateway processing remains a separate trace?
rationale: Tests can establish correctness and privacy properties, but they cannot decide whether these signal names, lifecycle boundaries, and the initial cross-process correlation limitation are the permanent operator-facing product contract.

options.title: Sponsor the current contract
options.body: Approve the documented signal set and lifecycle semantics now, with gateway context propagation tracked as separate future work.

options.title: Narrow the initial surface
options.body: Land only the core turn and latency signals, deferring history and detailed terminal metrics until maintainers settle the long-term contract.

options.title: Defer for end-to-end tracing
options.body: Pause the feature until the gateway protocol can propagate trace context and produce one correlated distributed trace.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the current contract
recommendation.body: Approve the documented signal set and lifecycle semantics now, with gateway context propagation tracked as separate future work.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history most directly connects this person to tray diagnostics and repository-level observability direction.
